title: Tangible Commands
description: Adds craftable items that act as utility commands such as /back or /spawn.
body:
Introduces multiple craftable consumable items that act as utility commands such as those found in FTB Essentials. Tangible Recipes also adds some of its own unique commands and implements every item independently from command mods, so it does not require any of them installed.

These consumables begin with 1 durability but can be combined in a crafting table or an anvil to boost their uses without needing multiple unstackable consumables in your inventory. Some specific consumables have only 1 durability and some are not even consumables, having infinite uses.

![Some recipes added](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/609797399587aced5157fd65de778248b068cb38.png)

###### _Some of the default recipes and items added._

 

__**Currently added commands:**__

*   **/corpse** - Pulls the nearest corpse from the [Corpse mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/corpse) within 50 blocks to you.
*   **/wits** - Improved version of the original /wits command added by the [What Is This Structure mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/wits). Includes better formatting for better readibility to players.

These commands are not available with this mod as only items are added. They can still be used through the items the mod adds. Install the standalone version of these mods to use the commands outside of the items.

__**Currently added items:**__

*   **Architectural Encyclopedia** - Effect similar to the /wits command, displaying the name of the structure at the player location. Has infinite uses.
*   **Soul Scroll** - Effect similar to the /back command, teleporting the player to their last death location. 1-25 uses.
*   **Cadaver Lure** - Pulls corpses from the corpse mod within 50 blocks to you. 1-25 uses.
*   **Wishing Stew** - Effect similar to the /rtp command, teleporting the player randomly in a 25k block area and acts as food. 1 use.
*   **Blazing Star** - Effect similar to the /spawn command, teleporting the player to world spawn. 1-25 uses.
*   **Dreamy Pillow** - Effect similar to the /bed command, teleporting the player to their current spawnpoint. 1-25 uses.

__**Mod compatibility:**__

*   [Corpse mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/corpse)

[ReversTeam Discord Server](https://discord.com/invite/TJKZgr6UDg)

 

Feel free to use in modpacks.
